dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。今日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm your counselor. I look forward to speaking with you today.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: はじめに、年齢、性別を伺ってもいいですか？
dialogue.English: To start, would it be alright to ask your age and gender?

dialogue.content: もし、答えたくなかったら大丈夫ですよ。今日はどんなご相談か教えてください
dialogue.English: If you'd rather not answer, that's perfectly fine. Could you tell me what you'd like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: つらい
dialogue.English: It's tough.

dialogue.content: つらい…どんなことにつらいと感じていますか？
dialogue.English: Tough... What is it that feels tough for you?

dialogue.content: 学校に行けない
dialogue.English: I can't go to school.

dialogue.content: 学校に行けないことがつらいのかな。うん、その状況はつらいでしょうね。他にもつらいと感じることはありますか？
dialogue.English: So, it sounds like not being able to go to school is what's tough for you. Yes, that must be a tough situation. Are there other things that feel tough as well?

dialogue.content: わからない
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、分からなくて大丈夫ですよ。学校に行けなくてつらい気持ちを抱えているのは、いつ頃からかな。
dialogue.English: I see, and it's okay not to know. About how long have you been feeling distressed about not being able to go to school?

dialogue.content: 先週から学校に行けなくなった
dialogue.English: I haven't been able to go to school since last week.

dialogue.content: 最近のお話なんですね、何かきっかけとかあったのかな
dialogue.English: So this is something recent. I wonder, was there some kind of trigger?

dialogue.content: 学校に行こうとするといつもお腹が痛くなる
dialogue.English: Whenever I try to go to school, my stomach always hurts.

dialogue.content: ああ、そうなんですね。お腹痛くなってしまうんだね。今はこうして話している時は大丈夫ですか
dialogue.English: Oh, I see. So your stomach ends up hurting. Are you feeling okay right now as we're talking?

dialogue.content: 学校行ってないから大丈夫
dialogue.English: I'm not at school, so I'm okay.

dialogue.content: そうか、そうか、大丈夫というお返事が聞けると安心します。お腹痛くなってしまうのは先週よりもっと前からなのかな
dialogue.English: I see, I see. It's reassuring to hear that you're okay. Has the stomach pain been happening for longer than just last week?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: じゃあ、ずっと抱えていてしんどかったね
dialogue.English: So, you've been carrying this for a while. That must have been really tough.

dialogue.content: 学校に無理して行っていたのかな
dialogue.English: Were you forcing yourself to go to school?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね、誰かに相談したりしましたか？親御さんや先生など、身近な人はどうでしたか？
dialogue.English: I see. Have you talked to anyone about it? What about people close to you, like your parents or teachers?

dialogue.content: 親は知ってる
dialogue.English: My parents know.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、親御さんはあなたがそういう時にどんなことをしてくれましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. What did your parents do for you when that happened?

dialogue.content: 学校に休む連絡をしてくれました
dialogue.English: They contacted the school to let them know I'd be absent.

dialogue.content: うん。親御さんはあなたのことを心配しているでしょうね。そういうのも、あなた自身をもっとつらい気持ちにさせたりしているのでしょうか。親御さんとは気兼ねなくお話しできる関係ですか？
dialogue.English: Yes. Your parents are probably worried about you. Does that, in turn, make you feel even more distressed? Do you have a relationship where you can talk openly with them?

dialogue.content: 答えづらかったら無理しなくて大丈夫ですよ。今、学校に行けなくてつらい気持ちを抱えているあなたに、少しでも気持ちが楽になるような時間になれたらうれしいです。あなた自身は、どんなことができたら、どうなったら一番良いと思いますか？
dialogue.English: If it's hard to answer, please don't feel any pressure. While you're struggling with not being able to go to school, I hope this time can help you feel even a little lighter. For yourself, what do you think would be the best outcome, or what would you like to be able to do?

dialogue.content: 前は学校に行けてたのに、行こうとするとお腹が痛くなって、行けなくなって、先週からは学校を休んでつらい気持ちなんだよね？例えば、お腹が痛くならなかったら学校に行けるのかな。いかがですか？
dialogue.English: You used to be able to go to school, but then your stomach started to hurt when you tried to go, and you couldn't. Since last week, you've been absent and feeling distressed, is that right? For example, if your stomach didn't hurt, do you think you could go to school? What do you think?

dialogue.content: はい、行けます
dialogue.English: Yes, I could go.

dialogue.content: お返事ありがとうございます。前は、お腹が痛くなると、どうしていたんですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for answering. Before, when your stomach would hurt, what did you do?

dialogue.content: がまんしてました
dialogue.English: I just put up with it.

dialogue.content: がまんして行っていたんですね、自分で乗り越えようと頑張っていたんだね。学校から帰るまでは痛みは大丈夫でしたか？
dialogue.English: So you endured it and went, trying to push through on your own. Was the pain manageable until you got home from school?

dialogue.content: 大丈夫なときもあった
dialogue.English: There were times it was okay.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫でないときもあった、のかな。どんな時だったのかな
dialogue.English: So there were times it wasn't okay, I imagine. What were those times like?

dialogue.content: ほぼずっと痛いし気持ち悪い
dialogue.English: It pretty much hurt the whole time, and I felt sick.

dialogue.content: それはしんどかっただろうね、よくがまんしてきたね
dialogue.English: That must have been really tough. You've done well to endure it for so long.

dialogue.content: 親御さんもあなたの苦しみは知っていらっしゃるのかもしれないけれど、痛みや気持ち悪さをよくするために、何かしてきたことはありますか？例えば、お薬とか病院へ行くなど…
dialogue.English: Your parents may know how much you're suffering, but have you done anything to help with the pain and nausea? For example, taking medication or going to see a doctor?

dialogue.content: 薬飲んで学校行ったことはある
dialogue.English: I've taken medicine and gone to school before.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、その時は大丈夫だったのかな？
dialogue.English: I see. Did it help at those times?

dialogue.content: よくわかんない
dialogue.English: I don't really know.

dialogue.content: そうか、うん、お薬の効き目って目に見えないものだから分かりづらいですよね。今はお薬のんでも行ける感じじゃないのかな
dialogue.English: I see. Yes, it's hard to tell how well medicine is working when the effects aren't visible, isn't it? Right now, does it feel like you couldn't go even if you took some?

dialogue.content: そんな感じ
dialogue.English: Something like that.

dialogue.content: そうか、そうか。お腹が痛くならないと学校に行けるのにーって感じかな学校は、あなたにとって大事な居場所なのかな。本当は学校に行くことをどう思っていますか？
dialogue.English: I see, I see. So it feels like, "If only my stomach didn't hurt, I could go to school." Is school an important place for you? How do you really feel about going to school?

dialogue.content: あんまり行きたくない
dialogue.English: I don't really want to go.

dialogue.content: あなたの気持ちを聞かせてくれてありがとう。うん、本当はあまり行きたくないし、行きたくなかったのかな。ずっと本当の気持ちを我慢してきたのかな。行きたくない気持ちでもいいんですよ
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing your feelings with me. So, you don't really want to go, and perhaps you haven't wanted to for a while now. Maybe you've been holding back your true feelings for a long time? It's okay to feel that you don't want to go.

dialogue.content: 行きたくない気持ちだって、お腹が痛くなければ学校に行けると思う気持ちも、あなた自身の本当の気持ちです。
dialogue.English: The feeling of not wanting to go, and the feeling that you could go if your stomach didn't hurt—both are your true feelings.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今までがまんして学校に行くようにしていて、「本当は行きたくなかった」のはよほど、あなた自身に負担だったのでは、と思います
dialogue.English: Forcing yourself to go to school all this time while secretly not wanting to must have been a huge burden on you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今は先のことを考えて出口の見えないような気持ちになることもあると思いますが、今まで耐えてきた分、少し長めの夏休みと思っても良いと思いますよ
dialogue.English: Right now, you might feel like there's no end in sight when you think about the future, but considering how much you've endured, I think it's okay to treat this as a slightly extended summer break.

dialogue.content: ゆっくり好きなことをしてみたり、気分転換になるようなこと、今はお腹が痛くならないなら、きっとできますよ
dialogue.English: You can take your time to do things you enjoy, or something that will be a nice change of pace. Since your stomach doesn't hurt now, I'm sure you can.

dialogue.content: 今、ご気分はどうかな？
dialogue.English: How are you feeling right now?

dialogue.content: またお話しできたらいいです。今日はありがとうございました。一緒にこれからも考えていきましょう。
dialogue.English: I hope we can talk again. Thank you for your time today. Let's continue to work through this together.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: それでは今日は失礼します。ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: We’ll end here for today. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.
